app_fee.value: Central research degree application guidance publishes no application fee for postgraduate research degrees; applications are submitted online.

fee_waiver.value: Central guidance does not publish fee waiver procedures as no general PGR application fee is stated.

gre_general.value: GRE General test is not required or requested centrally for postgraduate research admission at Southampton.

toefl_min.value: English language requirements vary by programme band (Bands A to I); specific requirements are detailed on individual course and project pages.
toefl_min.quote: Each course has its own English language proficiency requirement, expressed as an English language band (A to I) and its International English Language Testing System (IELTS) equivalent. Your offer letter will tell you which band you need to meet.

ielts_min.value: English language requirements vary by programme band (Bands A to I); specific requirements are detailed on individual course and project pages.
ielts_min.quote: Each course has its own English language proficiency requirement, expressed as an English language band (A to I) and its International English Language Testing System (IELTS) equivalent. Your offer letter will tell you which band you need to meet.

english_waiver.value: Exemption applies only to applicants from a recognised majority English-speaking country; other international applicants must provide evidence of proficiency.
english_waiver.quote: If you are from a majority English-speaking country you do not need to provide evidence of your English language proficiency.

notes: Postgraduate research degrees at the University of Southampton include PhD and Integrated PhD programmes across faculties.
